caption_L1: This bar diagram is named Leading countries in new installed wind power capacity in 2019 (in megawatts). A categorical scale with Argentina on one end and United States at the other can be found along the x-axis, marked Country. A linear scale from 0 to 25,000 can be found along the y-axis, labeled New installed capacity in megawatts.
caption_L2L3: The trends of leading countries installing wind power capacity in 2019 show that China is by far the leading country with an output of over 25,000 megawatts with the USA in second place, India in third place, Germany in fourth place, Sweden in fifth place and France in sixth place.
